title: Noom — a shoppable Shopify theme preset by UTD
description:
Noom is the home, wellness and services preset of Boutique — a premium Shopify theme by UTD, published in the official Shopify Theme Store.

A styled room photo becomes shoppable: tap an image hotspot, pick the size, add to cart — without ever leaving the page. Unlimited hotspots, twenty settings each.

What else is built in: quick buy, slide-out cart, cross-selling, gift wrapping, colour swatches, swatch filters, mega menu, enhanced search, stock counters, product videos — sixty-three features in total. The Pricing table section lines up three plans without a page builder, and Our team puts founders beside video.

100% positive in the official Shopify Theme Store, from 24 reviews.
$160 — one-time payment, lifetime licence. No subscription, ever.
Try it free in your own store — pay only when you publish.

Boutique in the Shopify Theme Store: https://themes.shopify.com/themes/boutique
All UTD themes: https://themes.shopify.com/themes?q=utd
Developed by UTD — https://utdweb.team

AI disclosure: the voice-over and the background music are AI-generated. Every screen in this video is a real capture of our own live Noom demo store.
